summary: Chart: every marker shape has the area of the circle it stands beside and sits on its area centroid (lib/viz markerPoints). Measured at r 4 before: the square was 27% heavier than the circle, the diamond 8%, the triangle 10% lighter and the plus 19%, and the triangle's centroid sat 1px (a quarter of r) below the data point, so on a line the marker read as off the line. Hexagon and pentagon were already equal-area. Legend and tooltip keys are fitted to their box and do not change. Found by /review-ui on the Marker shapes section; the section and the Line sheet were redrawn to match.
